en: Dilara Koz makes installations (placements) and publications, occasionally delivering performance-lectures. Her practice moves the between observation of space and its documentation, oftentimes resulting in derealised images that disrupt the conventional definition of their contents, or works of text that strive towards diluting signification. She is the art director of New Papers and a visiting tutor at Istanbul Technical University and MEF University.

Exhibitions and book fairs include Multiple Times, Indigo+Madder, London (2025); A Book Showcase, Reference Point, London (2025); The Luster, Vitruta, London (2025); Spill, SEESAW, Manchester (2025); Border_less, YKKSM, Istanbul (2025); Missing Objects, Milan (2025); The Echo Chamber, Deptford Town Hall, London (2025); Lattice Structure of Space-Time, Indigo+Madder, London (2024); Bound Art Book Fair, Whitworth, Manchester (2024); I Never Read, Kaserne, Basel (2024); Proem, Glogau_Air, Berlin (2024); Caressed and Polished and Drained and Washed, Filet, London (2024); and Border_less, YKKSM, Istanbul (2024).
fr: Dilara Koz réalise des installations (placements) et des publications, et présente occasionnellement des conférences performées. Sa pratique se situe à l’intersection de l’observation de l’espace et de sa documentation, donnant souvent lieu à des images déréalisées qui perturbent la définition conventionnelle de leur contenu, ou à des œuvres textuelles qui tendent à dissoudre la signification. Elle est directrice artistique de New Papers et enseignante invitée à l’Université technique d’Istanbul ainsi qu’à l’Université MEF.

Parmi ses expositions et participations à des foires du livre figurent : Multiple Times, Indigo+Madder, Londres (2025) ; A Book Showcase, Reference Point, Londres (2025) ; The Luster, Vitruta, Londres (2025) ; Spill, SEESAW, Manchester (2025) ; Border_less, YKKSM, Istanbul (2025) ; Missing Objects, Milan (2025) ; The Echo Chamber, Deptford Town Hall, Londres (2025) ; Lattice Structure of Space-Time, Indigo+Madder, Londres (2024) ; Bound Art Book Fair, Whitworth, Manchester (2024) ; I Never Read, Kaserne, Bâle (2024) ; Proem, Glogau_Air, Berlin (2024) ; Caressed and Polished and Drained and Washed, Filet, Londres (2024) ; ainsi que Border_less, YKKSM, Istanbul (2024).
